statements.statement: WITH params AS (SELECT CAST('2026-09-25' AS DATE) AS snap_current, CAST('2025-09-26' AS DATE) AS snap_yago), live AS (SELECT f.SNAPSHOT_DATE, f.SEASON, f.PARK_XID, f.BOOKING_ID, f.TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE FROM HAVEN_STORE.HOLIDAY.FCT_HOLIDAY_BOOKINGS AS f JOIN HAVEN_STORE.HOLIDAY.DIM_BOOKING_STATUS AS s ON f.BOOKING_STATUS_XID = s.BOOKING_STATUS_XID CROSS JOIN params AS p WHERE f.SNAPSHOT_DATE IN (p.snap_current, p.snap_yago) AND s.BOOKING_STATUS_CATEGORY = 'FIRM' AND ((f.SNAPSHOT_DATE = p.snap_current AND f.SEASON = 2027) OR (f.SNAPSHOT_DATE = p.snap_yago AND f.SEASON = 2026))), headline /* headline totals */ AS (SELECT SEASON, SNAPSHOT_DATE, COUNT(*) AS live_bookings, SUM(TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE) AS total_accomm_value FROM live GROUP BY 1, 2), park_ranked /* top 5 parks for current season */ AS (SELECT pk.PARK_NAME, COUNT(*) AS live_bookings, SUM(l.TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE) AS total_accomm_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM live AS l JOIN HAVEN_STORE.COMMON.DIM_PARK AS pk ON l.PARK_XID = pk.PARK_XID WHERE l.SEASON = 2027 GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'HEADLINE' AS section, CAST(SEASON AS VARCHAR) AS label, CAST(SNAPSHOT_DATE AS VARCHAR) AS snapshot, live_bookings, total_accomm_value FROM headline UNION ALL SELECT 'TOP5_PARK', PARK_NAME, NULL, live_bookings, total_accomm_value FROM park_ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY section, label

input.description: Live bookings 2027 season vs 2026 season YoY, plus top 5 parks
input.sql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    '2026-09-25'::DATE AS snap_current,
    '2025-09-26'::DATE AS snap_yago
),
live AS (
  SELECT
    f.SNAPSHOT_DATE,
    f.SEASON,
    f.PARK_XID,
    f.BOOKING_ID,
    f.TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE
  FROM HAVEN_STORE.HOLIDAY.FCT_HOLIDAY_BOOKINGS f
  JOIN HAVEN_STORE.HOLIDAY.DIM_BOOKING_STATUS s
    ON f.BOOKING_STATUS_XID = s.BOOKING_STATUS_XID
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE f.SNAPSHOT_DATE IN (p.snap_current, p.snap_yago)
    AND s.BOOKING_STATUS_CATEGORY = 'FIRM'
    AND (  (f.SNAPSHOT_DATE = p.snap_current AND f.SEASON = 2027)
        OR (f.SNAPSHOT_DATE = p.snap_yago   AND f.SEASON = 2026) )
),

-- headline totals
headline AS (
  SELECT
    SEASON,
    SNAPSHOT_DATE,
    COUNT(*)                          AS live_bookings,
    SUM(TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE)    AS total_accomm_value
  FROM live
  GROUP BY 1,2
),

-- top 5 parks for current season
park_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pk.PARK_NAME,
    COUNT(*)                          AS live_bookings,
    SUM(l.TOTAL_ACCOMMODATION_VALUE)  AS total_accomm_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM live l
  JOIN HAVEN_STORE.COMMON.DIM_PARK pk ON l.PARK_XID = pk.PARK_XID
  WHERE l.SEASON = 2027
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT 'HEADLINE' AS section, CAST(SEASON AS VARCHAR) AS label,
       CAST(SNAPSHOT_DATE AS VARCHAR) AS snapshot, live_bookings, total_accomm_value
FROM headline

UNION ALL

SELECT 'TOP5_PARK', PARK_NAME, NULL, live_bookings, total_accomm_value
FROM park_ranked WHERE rn <= 5

ORDER BY section, label
